name: Harvest Time
overview: Scripture portrays harvest time as a divinely appointed season of gathering and thanksgiving, symbolizing both physical provision and spiritual realities. The feast of harvest, described in Exodus 23:16, highlights the importance of offering firstfruits to God as an act of honor and gratitude, echoed in Proverbs 3:9. Jesus teaches in Matthew 9:37 and 13:30–37 that the harvest is abundant but requires diligent laborers, illustrating the separation of the righteous from the wicked at the time of judgment. This theme calls believers to joyful praise (Psalms 100:1) and faithful participation in God's redemptive work.
